page_title: MCI 3-1 BOU | Manchester City v Bournemouth 20/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 3 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 3:1.
90+2' Ilkay Gundogan comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
90+2' Here is a change. Bernardo Silva is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
90+1' A substitution has been made. Omar Marmoush goes off and Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) comes on.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 0 Nico (Manchester City) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
88' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
87' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
86' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

86' Julio Soler (Bournemouth) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
85' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
83' Substitution. Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) replaces Evanilson.
83' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Milos Kerkez will be replaced by Julio Soler (Bournemouth).
83' It's time for a substitution. Rodri (Manchester City) comes on in place of Erling Haaland.
82' What a chance to score from the free kick by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post.
80' A player from Bournemouth commits a rough challenge. Thomas Bramall blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Manchester City.
78' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
76' Nico (Manchester City) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
75' Nico (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Thomas Bramall sends him off the pitch.
72' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adam Smith (Bournemouth), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
69' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Adam Smith (Bournemouth) replaces Julian Araujo.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nico (Manchester City) is coming onto the pitch as Kevin De Bruyne cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Ederson (Manchester City) attempts to discuss the decision with Thomas Bramall, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
67' Thomas Bramall shows a red card with no hesitation. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
65' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared.
65' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
65' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

64' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
63' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
60' A pass from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is intercepted by Kepa Arrizabalaga and the move breaks down.
59' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
57' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) attempts to find David Brooks, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
55' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
55' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Manchester City get a corner.
53' Thomas Bramall blows for a foul after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
52' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
50' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
50' David Brooks (Bournemouth) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
47' Evanilson (Bournemouth) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
46' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes on the pitch for Justin Kluivert.
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Bramall starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
45+1' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the free kick and hits the target, but Kepa Arrizabalaga is alert and denies him with ease.
44' Julian Araujo (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Bramall ignores the protests.
43' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ederson, who smothers the ball.
40' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
38' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Ilkay Gundogan feeds Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
37' The linesman raises his flag. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is adjudged offside.
36' A yellow card for a tackle by Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth). Thomas Bramall doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
36' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
35' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
33' Evanilson (Bournemouth) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
32' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) is caught offside!
30' The ball is cleared after Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
28' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

25' OFF THE BAR! Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
24' Bournemouth seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Kepa Arrizabalaga and he makes a comfortable save.
21' A pass by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
18' Bournemouth couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Ederson (Manchester City) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
17' Thomas Bramall blows the whistle, Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul.
14' 1 - 0 Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) smashed the ball from long distance into the top left corner of the opponent’s goal. The shot went in off the left-hand post. Truly outstanding screamer!
14' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' One of the players from Manchester City times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Thomas Bramall who sees an offensive foul.
10' CHANCE! Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Kepa Arrizabalaga, who reacts superbly to stop him.
9' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
8' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
6' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
4' Good clearance! Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
4' A snap shot by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Ederson produces a good save to thwart him.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Thomas Bramall is the one to supervise the game today.
